scripts.db:up: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml up -d --wait
scripts.db:status: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml ps
scripts.db:logs: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml logs new-talents-postgres
scripts.db:stop: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml stop new-talents-postgres
scripts.db:start: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml start new-talents-postgres
scripts.db:restart: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml restart new-talents-postgres
scripts.db:down: npm run db:validate-env && docker compose --env-file docker/.env -f docker/compose.yaml down
scripts.verify:config: node --test tools/verify-toolchain.test.mjs docker/validate-environment.test.mjs && npm run test:config --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify:foundation: node tools/verify-foundation.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:backend:contract && npm run test:backend:integration && npm run db:verify-persistence
